rules.rationale: Diuretics are used to treat acute heart failure syndrome.
rules.citation: The use of loop diuretics [SNOMED: 372691009] in the management of acute heart failure [SNOMED: 56675007] induces [SNOMED: 16404004] an increase in sodium [SNOMED: 39972003] and water excretion by the kidney [SNOMED: 17373004], thus reducing [SNOMED: 260400001] preload [SNOMED: 13085001000001100] on the heart [SNOMED: 80891009].

rules.rationale: Diuretics should not be given if the patient does not have acute heart failure syndrome or volume overload.
rules.citation: Potential Harm of Implementing the Recommendations: Giving diuretics [SNOMED: 372695000] too early to a patient who is ultimately proven [SNOMED: 277025001] not to have the diagnosis [SNOMED: 887161000000102] of acute heart failure [SNOMED: 56675007] syndrome or when the patient is not experiencing volume overload [SNOMED: 21639008] as a cause [SNOMED: 134198009] of their acute heart failure [SNOMED: 56675007] syndrome could be harmful.
